subject: Transportation Systems
title: Freight Railroads in America
description: One-minute skill: Freight Railroads in America.

hook.text: America's freight railroads are the envy of the world. They're private, profitable, and enormous.

buildup.text: They haul coal, grain, chemicals, and containers across 140,000 miles of track.

discovery.text: A single freight train replaces 300 trucks. For heavy goods over long distances, rail is unbeatable.

twist.text: The same private ownership that makes freight efficient also blocks passenger rail from using the tracks.

climax.text: America chose freight over passengers. Europe chose the reverse. Both regret what they gave up.

punchline.text: America's best railway system is the one nobody rides.

quiz.question: Why is US freight rail considered world-class?
options: It's privately owned, profitable, and replaces hundreds of trucks per train
